scope: Static read-only inspection of pre-existing JADX recovery. No execution, rebuilding, server contact or repair.

findings.detail: M6 creates fake lock view y5, wires callback p2.a0, adds accessibility overlay (type 2032). y5.e receives user-submitted string; first attempt invokes ScreenMirrorService.j, which stores it as PIN/pattern/password. This is not extraction of arbitrary Google saved passwords.

findings.confidence: high capability; connecting edge requires verification
findings.detail: B dispatches event types click 1, focus 8, text-change 16; text-change/focus queue only when f4314h enabled by K. c reads node/event text, beforeText, password flags. ScreenMirrorService initializes j5 and delegates incoming accessibility events to G4. Direct call path to j5.B not fully confirmed.

Manifest registers boot, locked boot, user unlocked/present, package replaced. onReceive branches on action and helper state, invoking recovery-related helpers. Does not survive uninstall; receiver needs installed app and OS delivery.

findings.confidence: direct invocation confirmed by DEX/REA; runtime installation unobserved
findings.detail: CORRECTION: REA A10 confirms w1.cf.B(String):String invokes w1.z0.a(Context,File) at DEX code-unit offset187. Java grep missed cf.B because decompilation failed. Disassembly cf__74f76651.txt:1355-1494 shows local path checks: nonempty, existing file, positive size <=150MiB, canonical app-cache/external-cache containment, and installation-source authorization. No URL downloading in B. w1.ja.run command dispatcher invokes B (ja__276d98c9.txt:204-216). Session commit is not proof of successful installation and no third APK installation was observed.
Wrapper h(File) opens Android VIEW intent with APK MIME type via FileProvider; V0.e.run invokes h(file) in install branch. OS authorization/confirmation still relevant.

l5 processes accessibility/foreground protection conditions; contains CoreProtectionGuard blocked-page logs. Do not equate all uninstall strings with anti-uninstall: other branches intentionally initiate self-uninstall.

Small selector L6(int) invokes M6 on main thread or posts ua case1. pa.run case2 invokes L6 when view absent, persisted lock_mask_active and G0 true; background screenshot fallback or callbacks also invoke L6. Does not establish original command source.
